$comment: Controls budget (plans/site-v2.md, slice 3b): every interactive element on each built page and its job. Keyed by route pattern (srcRoute in .next/prerender-manifest.json). 'layout' entries apply to every page rendered inside the root layout; a route with "layout": false renders its own document. Entry: {kind, href or name, count (default 1, or "many"), job}. Kinds: link, button, input, select, textarea, summary, iframe, role-button, focusable, plus the classes "prose links" (any link inside .prose) and "scroll regions" (tabindex=0 on a scrolling pre, table or region). Checked by npm run lint:slop -- --built.

layout.job: skip past the navigation to the page content (keyboard and screen reader users)
go to the home page (the name in the nav)

controls.job: open a post from the recent writing list
go back to the list of posts
follow a source or page the post cites
scroll a wide code block or table by keyboard
see his code on GitHub (from the CV header)
follow the paper, GitHub and LinkedIn links in the About text
leave a missing page for the home page
leave a missing page for the list of posts
reload the site from the home page after an error
